canonicalSourceAtPreparation.warning: This integrated SHA is not attested into the Windows workspace and is not an authorization binding. Rebuild the runtime binding after a fresh Runner snapshot and job-specific source attestation exist.

execution.protectedOperation: external-agent dispatch via trusted Windows Runner

runnerEvidence.requiredOwnerOrOperatorAction: Refresh Runner registration/session and execute the real Codex probe; provide a fresh capability snapshot proving authenticated Codex readiness.

workspaceBinding.requiredOwnerOrOperatorAction: Bind the created job to this authorized workspace only after verifying repository, branch, exact integrated source SHA, package/source digest, and attestation.

pRecoveryGrant.ownerIdentityRule: Derive owner identity from authenticated server context at request time; never accept an owner ID from this manifest or client input.
requiredBindings: worker job ID, attempt ID, attempt number, and fencing version
fresh runner ID, session ID, capability snapshot ID and revision
exact integrated source commit, source tree, source manifest and artifact digests
attestation ID, decision epoch, and revision

ownerMustAuthorize: positive cap in currency minor units
approved non-production funding source and budget ID
tenant-scoped reserve/debit and release/credit ledger account IDs
economicAuthorization.workerJobGrantNote: Worker job grants are not the authority used by this trusted Runner path.

accountingPolicy.providerMetered: Capture only verified actual amount supported by provider usage provenance, usage digest, approved pricing policy, and balanced journal lines; release unused cap.
accountingPolicy.approvedSubscription: Require an explicit entitlement/accounting policy and usage reference; capture zero for this job and release the hold.
accountingPolicy.verifiedZeroCharge: Require an explicit zero-charge policy and verification reference; release the hold.
accountingPolicy.unknownFailedOrUntrusted: Create reconciliation evidence and leave the hold unchanged; never infer charges from token counts.
accountingPolicy.receiptSettlementService: Implemented in this checkpoint with deterministic validation tests; not wired to production until an authorized verifier/account source is configured.

requiredReceiptEvidence: verified accounting classification and usage provenance where applicable
idempotent settlement event and balanced actual-only capture/release journals
artifact collection digest and durable job completion state
ownerAction: After a real run/job/attempt exists and fresh Windows Codex readiness is recorded, the authenticated tenant owner must issue the exact P-RECOVERY grant and separately approve a positive non-production budget cap, funding source, ledger accounts, and accounting policy. No approval, grant, hold, ledger account, dispatch, or charge was created by this manifest.
